text: Setting project goals is essential for success. One useful method is using SMART goals, which means goals that are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. When you plan a project, you should also define clear milestones to track your progress. Milestones help you see if you are on schedule. In addition, you need to identify deliverables, which are the final products or results you must complete. Finally, stakeholder alignment is very important. This means making sure everyone involved agrees on the goals and understands their role. When all these elements are in place, your project is more likely to succeed.
